title: Hydrogen ion bond order
hints: Count electrons after making the cation.
Put it in the lowest orbital.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
statement:
What bond order does the MO model give $\ce{H2+}$?

[_]{a}

explanations: There is no antibonding electron to cancel it.
That would require two bonding electrons.
Hydrogen’s cation contains only one electron.
